description: Rewrite docs/ARCHITECTURE.md against the terms table agreed with user: conversation/exchange/invocation/step/model call/tool call/API call/branch/dispatch. Kill 'turn' throughout. Rename active_order -> goal. Rename compressor -> compactor. Fix tool-contract three-vs-four bug; split tools and skills as separate primitives; adopt progressive disclosure language. Disambiguate provider. Clean dispatcher/harness boundary. Set pass@1 with Wilson CI as primary metric. Every model call is a branch (invariant). Also amend AGENTS.md to ban terms of art not defined in docs/TAXONOMY.md without user approval.
title: Align ARCHITECTURE.md to taxonomy + ban undefined terms in AGENTS.md
